newsitem.title: USA: Dura to buy Excel brake business.
newsitem.headline: Dura to buy Excel brake business.

text.p: Dura Automotive Systems Inc said Monday it signed a non-binding letter of intent to acquire an automotive parking brake business from Excel Industries Inc.
Dura said the business has annual revenues of about $12 million, and its major customers are Chrysler Corp and General Motors Corp.
"This acquisition is an important element of our effort to consolidate the automotive driver control systems market," Karl Storrie, president of Dura, said in a statement.
Dura said the acquisition is expected to be completed by the end of the second quarter.
Dura designs and manufactures control mechanisms and cable-related systems for the automotive industry.
